categories.architecture: fires only through 9-arch, packages, or the instantiation of externs and blocks
categories.excluded-construct: the construct is excluded or elaborated away in docs/p4-spec-coverage.md; `row` names the row
categories.not-representable: the construct is in, but no input the printer can produce reaches this rule; the reason says why
categories.unhit: in scope and reachable from printable input, but not exercised yet; `reach` names the input that would. A to-do list for generated testing

exclusions.name: $shr_arith
exclusions.reason: Arithmetic right shift applies to signed `int<N>` operands, which are out of scope for v0 (coverage row for `int<N>`).

exclusions.name: $bitacc_replace
exclusions.reason: The runtime's slice write, called when a slice is the target of an assignment; the IR elaborates a slice lvalue into a read-modify-write of the whole field, so the printer never emits one, but a generated slice read reaches `$bitacc` only.
exclusions.reach: Not reachable through the printer while slice lvalues are elaborated away (coverage row `sliceLvalueIR`); reclassify as excluded-construct if that elaboration is kept.

exclusions.name: Callee_eval/abort

exclusions.name: Callee_eval/abort
exclusions.reason: The receiver is a sub-parser instance name, which cannot abort. SpecTec's structuring merges the three identical `.apply` abort rules (parser, control, table) into one instruction, attributed to the table rule at line 352, so this one has none of its own.

exclusions.name: Callee_eval/parenthesized
exclusions.reason: The printer parenthesizes only non-atomic operands, and every callee target it writes (a header, stack, instance or table reference, or `packet`) is atomic.

exclusions.name: Copy_in_arg/abort
exclusions.reason: An inout argument whose lvalue aborts: a sub-parser call with `hs[packet.lookahead<bit<32>>()]`.
exclusions.reach: The parser family's sub-parser takes `hdr` and a key byte, so no inout argument can fault. A sub-parser with an inout `h_t` parameter, called with a stack element indexed by a lookahead on a short packet, would reach it.
